title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 24th July 2026 | TV5 Money

recommendations.price: hold at current levels; don't sell
recommendations.note: Company is only just now recovering - hold, wait and watch until the subsidiary/demerger news plays out.
recommendations.detail: Caller Ashok holds Morepen Labs at a loss with no momentum and asked whether to hold; the anchor put the question to Kutumba Rao by name. He said at current levels he would say hold Morepen, because the company is only just now recovering. However, all the on-and-off news about their subsidiary and the demerger is not playing out; the company is doing pretty well as of now, but a bit of action in the market can only come after those play out. He noted a big mandate of about Rs 825 crore received recently, under commercial supplies, which has to be watched. His verdict: wait and watch - as of now don't sell, hold Morepen.

recommendations.note: No blanket verdict - the exit was on listing day (~20% returns); now judge power, aluminium and steel individually.
recommendations.detail: Pavan mailed that he holds Vedanta's demerged stocks, 500 shares of each company, and is now about Rs 62,000 in loss, asking whether to hold or book the loss and switch; the anchor named Kutumba Rao. He said each stock has to be analysed separately. If you wanted to treat all five demerged companies as a block, then on the first listing day they gave nearly 20% returns cum-demerger to ex-demerger, and one should have exited right then. From here power may behave one way, aluminium another way and the iron and steel business yet another way, so he said look at the individual stock and take action.

recommendations.price: book partial profits at current levels and keep a trailing stop loss (caller at 90% profit)
recommendations.note: Book partial profits with a trailing stop - hyper-activity post sanctions relief, but it is in ESM with a 2% range.
recommendations.detail: Tejpal Reddy mailed that he had invested Rs 80 lakh in Lokesh Machines and is now at a 90% profit, asking whether to sell or hold. Kutumba Rao said book partial profits and put a trailing stop loss, because after the American sanctions were removed recently activity returned to the stock and there is even a bit of hyper-activity. But if liquidity thins a little and it drops it will be either an upper circuit or a lower circuit, since it has been put into a 2% range - it is now in ESM. So: partial profit booking plus a trailing stop loss.
